subtitle: Some memories begin before a word is spoken. Discover a fragrance that makes your presence unforgettable.

collectionDescription: From the brightness of first light to the quiet depth of evening. Explore three moods of fragrance, and find a story that feels like you.
customDescription: Some scents take us back. Others express who we are without a single word. Let your memories and the things you love inspire a fragrance concept of your own.
customDialogDescription: This concept starts with your birthdate and favorite scents. Recommendations, options and details await the shop’s approval. This is a design preview; custom blending and ordering are not available yet.
